name: Town & Country Furniture
old_description: Town and Country Furniture is a family owned and operated furniture store and has served the Shenandoah Valley of Virginia for over 35 years. Our goal is to offer heirloom quality, solid wood, Amish Made and American Made furniture at affordable prices. We are a bit different than other furniture stores because we do not offer “Sale” pricing. We do not mark our prices up so that we can mark them back down; we give you the best price possible every day and delivery and set up by our friendly delivery men is very reasonably priced!
about:
Town & Country Furniture operates as a family-owned furniture retailer in Dayton, Virginia, where it has served the Shenandoah Valley for more than 35 years. The business was founded on a commitment to offering heirloom-quality solid wood pieces, primarily sourced from Amish and American makers, at straightforward everyday pricing.

The store carries collections from several established manufacturers, including Windy Valley Outdoor, La-Z-Boy, Zimmerman Chair, and Mount Eden Woodworks. Its showroom spans living room, dining room, bedroom, home office, children's room, and outdoor categories. In addition to sales, the company provides delivery and setup service performed by its own staff.

The customer base consists of residential buyers throughout the Shenandoah Valley region seeking solid wood and Amish-crafted furniture. The retailer positions itself as an alternative to promotional pricing models by maintaining a single best price year-round rather than cycling through sales events.

The company emphasizes its no-sale pricing philosophy and family-operated service as key differentiators, aiming to simplify the purchasing experience for homeowners furnishing their primary residences.
